    //==
    // # KdTree3D — k nearest neighbors

    // True when point j comes before point i: nearer, or equally near and
    // earlier in the point array.
    NeighborPrecedes(self: KdTree3D, center: Point3D, j: Integer, i: Integer): Boolean {
        var dj = self.Points[j].DistanceSquared(center);
        var di = self.Points[i].DistanceSquared(center);
        return dj < di || dj == di && j < i;
    }

    // How many points come strictly before point i.
    NeighborRank(self: KdTree3D, center: Point3D, i: Integer): Integer
        => self.Points.Count.Range.Reduce(0, (acc, j) => self.NeighborPrecedes(center, j, i) ? acc + 1 : acc);

    // The index of the point of the given rank, or -1 when there is none.
    NeighborAtRank(self: KdTree3D, center: Point3D, rank: Integer): Integer
        => self.Points.Count.Range.Reduce(-1, (acc, i) => self.NeighborRank(center, i) == rank ? i : acc);

    // How many results the query actually yields.
    NeighborResultCount(self: KdTree3D, query: KNearestQuery3D): Integer {
        var withinRadius = query.MaxDistance <= 0.0
            ? self.Points.Count
            : self.Points.Reduce(0, (acc, p) => p.Distance(query.Center) <= query.MaxDistance ? acc + 1 : acc);
        return query.NeighborCount.Min(self.Points.Count).Min(withinRadius).Max(0);
    }

    // The nearest points to the query centre, nearest first, paired with their
    // distances.
    FindNearest(self: KdTree3D, query: KNearestQuery3D): NearestNeighbors {
        var count = self.NeighborResultCount(query);
        var chosen = count.MapRange(r => self.NeighborAtRank(query.Center, r));
        return (chosen.Map(i => self.PointIndices[i]),
                chosen.Map(i => self.Points[i].Distance(query.Center)));
    }

    //==
    // # Derived functionality for spatial indexes and queries
    //
    // Pure, expression-bodied helpers for the interfaces declared in
    // `spatial.concepts.plato` (ISpatialIndex2D, ISpatialIndex3D) and
    // `spatial.concepts.plato` (IRaycast2D/3D,
    // IClosestPoint2D/3D, INearestNeighbor2D/3D). Part of P8 of the
    // interface library.
    //
    // Result records expose their fields, so hit/distance predicates just read them,
    // and the convenience overloads assemble the query records so a caller can cast a
    // bare ray or ask for a bare k-nearest count. Emptiness follows one pattern —
    // `IsEmpty` wherever no overload clash forces a prefixed spelling (per-interface
    // `IsEmpty` collisions are disambiguated by interface type).

    //==
    // ISpatialIndex2D — broad-phase candidate queries over indexed 2D primitives.
    // Candidates may include false positives; exact tests are the caller's phase two.

    // True when the index holds no primitives.
    IsEmpty(self: ISpatialIndex2D): Boolean
        => self.ItemCount.IsZero;

    // The number of candidate primitives overlapping the bounds (with false positives).
    CandidateCountInBounds(self: ISpatialIndex2D, bounds: Bounds2D): Integer
        => self.CandidatesInBounds(bounds).Count;

    // True when any candidate primitive overlaps the bounds.
    HasCandidatesInBounds(self: ISpatialIndex2D, bounds: Bounds2D): Boolean
        => self.CandidateCountInBounds(bounds).IsPositive;

    //==
    // ISpatialIndex3D — broad-phase candidate queries over indexed 3D primitives.

    // True when the index holds no primitives.
    IsEmpty(self: ISpatialIndex3D): Boolean
        => self.ItemCount.IsZero;

    // The number of candidate primitives overlapping the bounds (with false positives).
    CandidateCountInBounds(self: ISpatialIndex3D, bounds: Bounds3D): Integer
        => self.CandidatesInBounds(bounds).Count;

    // True when any candidate primitive overlaps the bounds.
    HasCandidatesInBounds(self: ISpatialIndex3D, bounds: Bounds3D): Boolean
        => self.CandidateCountInBounds(bounds).IsPositive;

    //==
    // IRaycast2D — anything a 2D ray can be cast against. The convenience
    // overloads build the RayQuery record so callers can cast a bare ray. A
    // MaxDistance of 0 means unbounded; a FilterMask of -1 accepts every category.

    // An unbounded, accept-all raycast request for a bare ray.
    UnboundedRayQuery(self: IRaycast2D, ray: Ray2D): RayQuery2D
        => (ray, 0.0, -1);

    // Cast a bare ray with no distance bound and no filtering.
    Raycast(self: IRaycast2D, ray: Ray2D): RayHit2D
        => self.Raycast(self.UnboundedRayQuery(ray));

    // True when the query strikes something.
    DidHit(self: IRaycast2D, query: RayQuery2D): Boolean
        => self.Raycast(query).Hit;

    // True when a bare unbounded, accept-all ray strikes something.
    DidHit(self: IRaycast2D, ray: Ray2D): Boolean
        => self.Raycast(ray).Hit;

    // True when the query strikes nothing.
    Missed(self: IRaycast2D, query: RayQuery2D): Boolean
        => self.DidHit(query).Not;

    // The distance from the ray origin to the first hit. Precondition: the query hits.
    HitDistance(self: IRaycast2D, query: RayQuery2D): Number
        => self.Raycast(query).Distance;

    // The world position of the first hit. Precondition: the query hits.
    HitPosition(self: IRaycast2D, query: RayQuery2D): Point2D
        => self.Raycast(query).Position;

    // The surface normal at the first hit, pointing against the ray. Precondition: hits.
    HitNormal(self: IRaycast2D, query: RayQuery2D): Direction2D
        => self.Raycast(query).Normal;

    // The struck primitive's index in the caller's list (-1 when inapplicable).
    // Precondition: the query hits.
    HitPrimitiveIndex(self: IRaycast2D, query: RayQuery2D): ItemIndex
        => self.Raycast(query).PrimitiveIndex;

    //==
    // IRaycast3D — anything a 3D ray can be cast against.

    // An unbounded, accept-all raycast request for a bare ray.
    UnboundedRayQuery(self: IRaycast3D, ray: Ray3D): RayQuery3D
        => (ray, 0.0, -1);

    // Cast a bare ray with no distance bound and no filtering.
    Raycast(self: IRaycast3D, ray: Ray3D): RayHit3D
        => self.Raycast(self.UnboundedRayQuery(ray));

    // True when the query strikes something.
    DidHit(self: IRaycast3D, query: RayQuery3D): Boolean
        => self.Raycast(query).Hit;

    // True when a bare unbounded, accept-all ray strikes something.
    DidHit(self: IRaycast3D, ray: Ray3D): Boolean
        => self.Raycast(ray).Hit;

    // True when the query strikes nothing.
    Missed(self: IRaycast3D, query: RayQuery3D): Boolean
        => self.DidHit(query).Not;

    // The distance from the ray origin to the first hit. Precondition: the query hits.
    HitDistance(self: IRaycast3D, query: RayQuery3D): Number
        => self.Raycast(query).Distance;

    // The world position of the first hit. Precondition: the query hits.
    HitPosition(self: IRaycast3D, query: RayQuery3D): Point3D
        => self.Raycast(query).Position;

    // The surface normal at the first hit, pointing against the ray. Precondition: hits.
    HitNormal(self: IRaycast3D, query: RayQuery3D): Direction3D
        => self.Raycast(query).Normal;
